Predictable Subspace Theorem
Acquiring and warranting a predictable output representation

Private Astra P3, 23 October 2026. Root construction and proof; independently
challenged by the existing structure-access worker. This develops the stronger
conventional Bernstein comparison into a vector operation. It does not claim
newness of conditional-mean PCA, reverse-martingale factories, or orthogonal
regression. Historical novelty of the complete charged composition is UNKNOWN.

1. Scientific question and obtainable input

Let an independently drawn digital checkpoint X have law mu. Repeated fresh
conditional continuations expose a strongly measurable vector Z in a real
separable Hilbert space, ||Z||<=1.
Write d(x)=E[Z|X=x], G=E[d d^], S=tr G=E||d||^2, and M2=E[Z Z^].
In the executable version, every observed vector has finitely many integer
coordinates divided by a known common positive integer denominator.

The task is to acquire an initially unknown low-dimensional output projection
P that retains predictable conditional responses, and to warrant its remaining
error E||(I-P)d||^2 from accessible experiments. A low-rank promise is NOT an
input. The procedure may fail to find a useful small P. It does not identify
the transition law, recognize an arbitrary model class, or certify all unseen
populations. The ordinary covariance M2 can be dominated by irreducible noise;
the relevant matrix is G, whose definition must not be mistaken for free access.

A learned conditional feature predictor f supplies a residual source by
Z=(phi(Y)-f(X))/R, with a warranted common bound R on the residual norm. The
source must actually provide the features and independent restarts. With
||phi||,||f||<=1, R=2 suffices. Without centering, G includes the common response
mean; centering is a task choice whose acquisition and scaling costs count.

The scalar paired-walk method remains useful and preserved. The conventional
envelope comparator matches its observation-rate order and, after a disclosed
finite design search, has smaller guaranteed source budgets on the three
tested accuracies. No general sampling-rate or architecture advantage survives
that comparison. The reason to continue here is an acquired representation and
its subsequent uses, not a larger scalar benchmark.

2. A compact vector survival operation

Within one checkpoint, put S_n=sum_(i<=n) Z_i and V_n=sum_(i<=n)||Z_i||^2.
At n=1 continue with probability ||Z_1||^2. At n>=2 continue with probability

r_n = (n-1)^2 ||S_n||^2 / [n((n-2)||S_n||^2+V_n)].        (1)

Set 0/0 to zero. The Cauchy inequality ||S_n||^2<=n V_n makes 0<=r_n<=1.
Stop at the first failed gate and output B=0; after N successful gates output
B=1. Every successful witness uses exactly N independent source observations.
Only the vector sum and its running energy are needed, not a conditional mean.

Proof without an invalid conditional-exchangeability assumption

For a fixed ordered tuple z_1,...,z_n, let F_n be the product of its survival
gates. F_n is generally NOT invariant under permutations: conditioning on
having survived destroys exchangeability. Instead symmetrize its UNCONDITIONAL
survival probability. If sym F_(n-1)=||S_(n-1)/(n-1)||^2, then

sym F_n
  = r_n * (1/n) sum_i ||(S_n-z_i)/(n-1)||^2
  = r_n * [(n-2)||S_n||^2+V_n]/[n(n-1)^2]
  = ||S_n/n||^2.                                      (2)

The n=1 base case is immediate. IID averaging, conditional on X, now gives

p_n(x)=P(B_n=1|X=x)
      =||d(x)||^2 + [E(||Z||^2|x)-||d(x)||^2]/n.        (3)

In particular S<=E B_N<=S+1/N. This is a finite positive-bias approximation,
not an exact nonnegative estimator of a functional with an interior zero.

Established general mechanism

More generally, symmetric potentials b_n in [0,1] satisfying
b_n<=average_i b_(n-1)(z_without_i) admit gates equal to the quotient. Their
symmetrized survival is b_n. Convex Phi(mean z) satisfies the inequality by
Jensen. The squared norm is computationally useful because its deletion
average has the O(dimension)-per-observation sufficient statistics in (1).
For generic Phi, evaluating all deletions may take O(n) potential evaluations
per step and invalidate a cheap-oracle claim.

This is a specialization of the compatible-envelope/reverse-martingale
framework, not an independently established new principle. Governing primary
sources: Nacu--Peres, arXiv:math/0309222v5, Section 2; and
Latuszynski--Kosmidis--Papaspiliopoulos--Roberts, arXiv:0907.4018v2,
Algorithm 4 and Theorem 2.5. Their exact formulas are distinguished from the
specializations derived in this branch in the external source notes.

3. Precision, confidence, and a deterministic work bound

Choose b with 2^b>=N^2 and round each gate UP to a multiple of 2^-b, using
exact integer division. Coupling each rounded gate to its unrounded one gives

0<=p_n^up-p_n<=n 2^-b,
S<=p^up:=E B_N^up<=S+2/N.                             (4)

The first gate is included. Zero and one gates need no random bits. With a
fixed common denominator, ||S_n||^2 and V_n use integer accumulators, so (1)
has no unstable floating denominator. An approximate dot product does NOT
automatically supply a valid upward gate enclosure.

Let W be observations consumed in a witness. Put v=E||Z||^2 and s=||d||^2
at its checkpoint. For N>=2, the exact failed-work identity is

E[W 1{B=0}|X]=1-v+(v-s)H_(N-1)<=H_(N-1).

Rounding increases this upper bound by at most
2^-b sum_(n=1)^(N-1) n <1/2. Since success costs exactly N,

E exp(W/N-B) <= 1+(2H_(N-1)+1)/N.                    (5)

Use ell>=ln(4/alpha), ell_R>=ln(2/alpha), h>=H_(N-1),

N=ceil(32/epsilon), n=ceil(16 ell/epsilon),
r=floor(n epsilon/2-ell)+1,
K=ceil(n(2h+1)+N(r+ell_R)).                           (6)

For n potential IID witnesses, H successes give
U=min(1,2H/n+2ell/n). Except with probability alpha/2,

S<=U<=4S+8/N+4ell/n<=4S+epsilon/2.                  (7)

The two Bernoulli exponential bounds are the same as in the paired theorem.
Stop inconclusively at r successes or BEFORE exceeding K source observations.
The supermartingale from (5), stopped at n witnesses or r successes, bounds
cap failure by alpha/2. A partly observed witness is not counted as a failure.
Thus every execution has at most K observations and n checkpoint preparations,
and S<=epsilon/8 gives certification probability at least 1-alpha.

The order is O(epsilon^-1 log(1/alpha) log(1/epsilon)) observations, plus
at most bK auxiliary fair bits, O(dimension*K) integer coordinate work and
the gate multiplications/divisions. For source numerator bit bound a, gate
operands have O(a+log N+b) bits; the multiplication/division bit complexity
must be included in CPU claims. Preparing/copying checkpoints, obtaining
features, evaluating f, source randomness, trajectory length and all training
or failed searches remain additional charged work.

The observation bound has no ambient-dimension factor only for genuinely
available unit-norm vectors. If all one knows is |Z_j|<=1 for m components,
normalizing by sqrt(m) changes the target to AVERAGE squared error. Certifying
total squared error epsilon then needs effective accuracy epsilon/m. Kernel
features require paid kernel evaluations or a separately warranted finite
approximation; they do not supply free infinite-dimensional arithmetic.

4. From acquired error mass to acquired predictable directions

The same earlier evidence can supply a lower warrant. For any observed prefix
of h0 successes from the n planned witnesses, on the upper-count event,

S>=s0=max(0,(h0-ell)/(2n)-2/N).                       (8)

This remains true after either early stop. Reaching r implies s0>epsilon/8.
A failed upper certificate alone is not evidence that S is large.

At a success retain the exact rank-one PSD matrix

A = (S_N S_N^*)/||S_N||^2,                          (9)

represented by its integer vector and denominator. Its trace is one; final
zero empirical mean cannot succeed because its gate is zero even after upward
rounding. A is permutation-invariant, so (2) proves

E[B_N A] = E[(S_N/N)(S_N/N)^*]
         =G+(M2-G)/N.                              (10)

Here M2-G is PSD. Rounding adds a PSD matrix of trace at most N2^-b.
Consequently

E[B_N^up A]=G+Delta,  Delta PSD, tr Delta<=2/N.

With p=E B_N^up, the conditional accepted matrix has mean

C=(G+Delta)/p=(1-beta)G/S+beta R,
beta=tr Delta/p<=2/(NS),                            (11)

where R is PSD trace one when Delta is nonzero. This is access to approximate
normalized predictable energy, not an oracle for G or a hidden decomposition.

A fixed, charged batch of accepted marks

Given a valid acquired s0>0, desired contamination eta and failure delta, set

N=ceil(2/(eta s0)), b=ceil(log2 N^2),
ell>=ln(2/delta), L=ceil(2(Rcount+ell)/s0),
K=ceil(L(2h+1)+N(Rcount+ell)).                       (12)

Attempt at most L fresh witnesses, stop at Rcount successes, or before K
observations. Return COMPLETE only if all Rcount marks were obtained. The
probability of too few successes in L attempts is at most
exp(Rcount-Lp/2)<=delta/2. Equation (5) gives another delta/2 for the work cap.
Every execution costs at most K observations, bK fair bits and L preparations.
Do not silently retry an incomplete batch.

Conditional on COMPLETE, these Rcount success marks are IID from their fixed
success law. To prove this, fix the interleaving of failed attempts and their
costs. All successful attempts cost exactly N. Completeness depends only on
that failure/cost skeleton and the fixed total Rcount*N; it does not depend on
the successful marks. The joint success-mark measure factors, and summing over
allowed skeletons preserves its product law. Variable source-dependent
wall-time caps do not inherit this fact.

Learn a projection without a low-rank recognition oracle

Average the acquired matrices to form C_hat, and propose a rank-k orthogonal
projection from its leading directions. Since ||A||_F=1,
E||C_hat-C||_F^2<=1/Rcount. Bounded differences additionally give

P(||C_hat-C||_F>1/sqrt(Rcount)+t)
   <=exp(-Rcount*t^2/2).

Indeed the expected norm is bounded by its second moment and replacing one
matrix changes it by at most 2/Rcount. The elementary bounded-difference
exponential argument then gives the displayed tail. This charges both the
number of successful marks and the work to obtain them; it is not a free
covariance estimate. Storing full matrices costs O(k_dimension^2); retaining
rank-one vectors can instead support paid iterative products.

No eigengap is needed to warrant approximation error. If P_hat is within tau
of maximizing tr(P C_hat) among rank-k orthogonal projections and
||C_hat-C||_F<=xi, then its true predictable-energy loss is at most

min_rank-k_P tr((I-P)G) + p*(sqrt(2k)*xi+tau)+tr Delta.

This follows by comparing P_hat to the optimum for G, using
||P_hat-P_star||_F<=sqrt(2k) and 0<=tr(P Delta)<=tr Delta.
Numerical eigensolver errors belong in tau if this bound is used.

An often simpler operational warrant is to FREEZE the proposed P and validate
fresh source (I-P)Z with the same certificate. It returns a direct bound on
E||(I-P)d||^2, irrespective of how P was proposed. A rank-one integer vector
v!=0 supplies the EXACT rational projector vv^*/(v^*v). Floating eigensolvers
can propose v; rounding v does not compromise exact orthogonality after that
rational construction. Higher rank needs an exactly represented orthogonal
projection or an additional numerical error allowance.

5. Composition into a subsequent learning task

Suppose phi(Y) is the bounded scientific output, m(x)=E[phi(Y)|x], and the
newly acquired projection has a valid warrant E||(I-P)m||^2<=epsilon_P.
A later learner receives labels P phi(Y), learns a function a(x) in range(P),
and acquires a separate warrant E||Pm-a||^2<=epsilon_a. Then exactly

E||m-a||^2 = E||(I-P)m||^2+E||Pm-a||^2
          <=epsilon_P+epsilon_a.                    (13)

This is a constructive compositional contract. Experience changes the unknown
output projection; that representation defines a new lower-dimensional
regression task; fresh observations warrant both stages. No claim that the
remaining input regression is easy follows without assumptions on that task.
For every later linear observable w with ||w||<=1, chosen after validation,
its squared conditional prediction error is at most epsilon_P+epsilon_a.
Under a new checkpoint law nu with independently warranted dnu/dmu<=C, the
bound becomes C(epsilon_P+epsilon_a). The conditional dynamics, feature map,
restart law and horizon must remain the same. Confidence failures of the two
fresh validation stages add by a union bound; repeated model search needs
proper fresh or reusable validation rather than uncharged retrying.

This operation does not require membership in an exact low-rank class. If the
data do not support a useful small projection, the warrant fails or is large.
It also does not prove a general law of cumulative intelligence. A retaining
program/library learner can run this entire composition; the capability is
acquired by an information-processing procedure, not unique to an architecture.

6. Strong alternatives and precise limits

An equally informed retained m-replica estimator directly acquires G unbiasedly:

U_i=[(sum Z)(sum Z)^* - sum ZZ^*]/[m(m-1)].

It needs only a vector sum and an outer-product accumulator. Across n
checkpoints, its Frobenius mean-square error is bounded by
[S(1+4/m)+2/(m(m-1))]/n. The derivation is the vector version of the earlier
U-statistic expansion: the linear noise term contributes at most 4S/m,
the degenerate term at most 2/(m(m-1)), and between-checkpoint variation at
most S. This estimator and conventional conditional PCA receive exactly the
same information, source code where available, observations and tools. They
must not be replaced by the weaker raw covariance M2 as the main comparison.
The streaming Bernstein method itself is a conventional same-rate alternative.

Scalar signed-orientation TV does not extend to exact vector directions. For
Z in {e1,e2} with probabilities (1/3,2/3), and N not divisible by 3, no empirical
direction equals the true mean direction. Their distributions have TV one,
even as angular error tends to zero. A valid weaker statement is accepted
expected squared angular error <=8/(NS) for the rounded design. It follows
from ||x||*||dir(x)-dir(d)||<=2||x-d|| and permutation symmetrization.

Copyable state is substantial access. With only one noisy label per opaque
unique state and no structural promise, conditional squared means need not be
identifiable from a bounded passive sample. An independently randomized hidden
deterministic response over a sufficiently large state set and a fair noisy
response have identical distinct-state transcript laws, yet different squared
conditional means; collisions are the source of distinction. The algorithm
does not synthesize physical copies or secretly assume a class recognizer.

No external scientific speedup or learned-representation transfer has been
demonstrated by the finite algebra fixtures. Full scientific costs and domain
coverage, particularly rare transition channels, remain consequential unknowns.
Primary scientific/prior comparison is preserved separately in the external
notes. The parent corpus remains pinned at
0451552424b4679fa9a73faf5849ea5a4af21cf6; N780's recognition obstruction is
respected, and N51 has not been used as an unknown-representation oracle.

7. Executable challenge and negative complete-process comparison

The code is vector_residual_certificate.py. Four small rational vector laws
were independently chosen and frozen by the structure-access worker before
that worker read this implementation. Root then froze the executable audit.
The exact audit passed 58,180 checks over 3,454 ordered prefixes and 24 rounded
law/horizon/precision cases. It verifies permutation averages, PSD marks,
rounded excess, failed-work identities and bounds, strict plan types and
incomplete-witness control flow. The original helper accepted an invalid
float zero-over-zero pair before checking precision; that invalid-input
finding and the pre-fix source are preserved. No valid-input theorem failure
was found. Administrative checkpoint IDs are retention metadata; IID mark
claims concern the physical checkpoint contents and rank-one matrices, not
their monotonically assigned serial identifiers.

The same independently authored laws were then used for ONE frozen
exploratory acquisition/projection/fresh-validation pipeline. Their moments
were exposed to root before that pipeline's budgets and seeds were frozen.
They are therefore not an unseen scientific transfer test. The explicit
atom law also admits cheap analytic solution, so no black-box computational
superiority follows from this fixture. The inference routines do not receive
its exact G or a projection. The auditor uses exact G only after proposals
are fixed, to challenge rather than supply the result.

Initial predictable energy was S=559/4800, about 0.116458. A 6,705-observation
pilot acquired the lower warrant 1003/32320. The positive-witness procedure
used 17,258 further vector observations to acquire 32 marks, proposed an exact
rational rank-one projector, and used 7,020 fresh observations to validate it.
Its true residual (auditor only) was about 0.00450354; its 99% upper certificate
was 133/8065, about 0.0164910. The source, gates, all failures, preparation and
integer/eigensolver timings are retained.

Strong ordinary comparisons used 512 checkpoints with eight retained replicas
each, obtaining both a U-statistic matrix and a PSD batch-mean matrix from the
same 4,096 observations. Each proposal received independent fresh validation
with the same epsilon=1/16 and alpha=1/100. The U-statistic projection had true
residual about 0.00454371 and certificate 103/8065; the batch-mean projection
had residual about 0.00481189 and certificate 163/8065. Both certified.

Necessary source costs from scratch were:

Process	Pilot	Representation acquisition	Fresh validation	Total vectors
Positive witnesses	6,705	17,258	7,020	30,983
Retained U-statistic	0	4,096	5,307	9,403
Retained batch means	0	4,096	8,808	12,904

The original frozen execution summary additionally charges the same shared
pilot to every method. That is an equal-context accounting convention, but
the fixed-depth methods do not need the pilot. The stronger from-scratch
interpretation above removes that unnecessary charge, with both records kept.
No seed, observation, method, rank, threshold or result was changed.

The whole shared experiment acquired 49,194 actual vector observations at
6,005 checkpoint preparations. Every observation was retained. All decisions
and both fixed-depth matrices replayed exactly from the original vector tapes;
auxiliary gate words were reconstructed from the originally frozen PRNG seeds,
with no new source observations. All methods used exact rational projection
for validation; floating eigensolvers only proposed integer vectors.

The comparison is negative for practical advantage in this fixture. It
preserves the acquired-representation construction but gives no basis for a
new architectural or efficiency claim. Conditional PCA, replicated matrix
estimation and orthogonal risk addition are established conventional machinery.
The exact finite-bit sequential theorem's historical priority remains UNKNOWN.

Exact records: VECTOR_AUDIT_RESULT.json; SUBSPACE_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.json;
subspace_execution/RESULT.json; subspace_execution/REPLAY_RESULT.json; and
subspace_execution/COST_INTERPRETATION_REFINEMENT.json. Primary comparisons:
../external/PREDICTABLE_OUTPUT_SUBSPACE_PRIOR.md and its source record.

An explicit boundary example is retained: X is either 1 or 2, and Z is an
independent random sign times e_X. Then d=0 and G=0, but E[Z_1^2|X] exactly
identifies X=1. A conditional-mean output representation warrants its declared
linear task family; it does not warrant arbitrary nonlinear future tasks or
learn an input encoder. Those are distinct remaining acquisition problems.

5. Composition into a subsequent learning task

Suppose phi(Y) is the bounded scientific output, m(x)=E[phi(Y)|x], and the
newly acquired projection has a valid warrant E||(I-P)m||^2<=epsilon_P.
A later learner receives labels P phi(Y), learns a function a(x) in range(P),
and acquires a separate warrant E||Pm-a||^2<=epsilon_a. Then exactly

E||m-a||^2 = E||(I-P)m||^2+E||Pm-a||^2 <=epsilon_P+epsilon_a. (13)

This is a constructive compositional contract. Experience changes the unknown
output projection; that representation defines a new lower-dimensional
regression task; fresh observations warrant both stages. No claim that the
remaining input regression is easy follows without assumptions on that task.
For every later linear observable w with ||w||<=1, chosen after validation,
its squared conditional prediction error is at most epsilon_P+epsilon_a.
Under a new checkpoint law nu with independently warranted dnu/dmu<=C, the
bound becomes C(epsilon_P+epsilon_a). The conditional dynamics, feature map,
restart law and horizon must remain the same. Confidence failures of the two
fresh validation stages add by a union bound; repeated model search needs
proper fresh or reusable validation rather than uncharged retrying.

This operation does not require membership in an exact low-rank class. If the
data do not support a useful small projection, the warrant fails or is large.
It also does not prove a general law of cumulative intelligence. A retaining

6. Strong alternatives and precise limits

An equally informed retained m-replica estimator directly acquires G unbiasedly:

U_i=[(sum Z)(sum Z)^* - sum ZZ^*]/[m(m-1)].

It needs only a vector sum and an outer-product accumulator. Across n
checkpoints, its Frobenius mean-square error is bounded by
[S(1+4/m)+2/(m(m-1))]/n. The derivation is the vector version of the earlier
U-statistic expansion: the linear noise term contributes at most 4S/m,
the degenerate term at most 2/(m(m-1)), and between-checkpoint variation at
most S. This estimator and conventional conditional PCA receive exactly the
same information, source code where available, observations and tools. They
must not be replaced by the weaker raw covariance M2 as the main comparison.
The streaming Bernstein method itself is a conventional same-rate alternative.

Scalar signed-orientation TV does not extend to exact vector directions. For
Z in {e1,e2} with probabilities (1/3,2/3), and N not divisible by 3, no empirical
direction equals the true mean direction. Their distributions have TV one,
even as angular error tends to zero. A valid weaker statement is accepted
expected squared angular error <=8/(NS) for the rounded design. It follows
from ||x||*||dir(x)-dir(d)||<=2||x-d|| and permutation symmetrization.

conditional means; collisions are the source of distinction. The algorithm
